mapper.sql: created_on, changed_on, id, name, `describe`, project_id, dag_json, namespace, global_env, schedule_type, cron_time, pipeline_file, pipeline_argo_id, version_id, run_id, node_selector, image_pull_policy, parallelism, alert_status, alert_user, expand, created_by_fk, changed_by_fk, depends_on_past, max_active_runs, parameter, expired_limit, cronjob_start_time, priority, type
mapper.select: SELECT p.id, pr.name as project, p.name, p.describe, p.version_id as version, a.nickname as creator, DATE_FORMAT(p.changed_on, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') as modified, p.expand, ae.name as aiExperimentName FROM pipeline p LEFT JOIN project pr ON p.project_id = pr.id LEFT JOIN ab_user a ON p.created_by_fk = a.id LEFT JOIN ai_experiment_pipeline aep ON p.id = aep.pipeline_id LEFT JOIN ai_experiment ae ON aep.experiment_id = ae.id WHERE p.id = #{id}
